title: SemanticMemory
description: Value shape stored in LangGraph Store (BaseStore/PostgresStore) under an authorized namespace tuple + key. Not a parallel DB schema by default.

namespace.description: Logical namespace; LangGraph Store uses a string tuple, e.g. [user_id, "semantic"]. Preferred user scope from JWT user_id.

store_key.description: LangGraph Store item key within the namespace

Memory.md.description: Markdown memory document body inside the Store value
